587	    def __init__(self) -> None:
588	        self.role = ROLE_FOLLOWER
589	        self.term = 0
590	        self.voted_for: str | None = None
591	        self.known_leader: str | None = None
592	        self.votes: set[str] = set()
593	        self.timeout_gen = 0
594	        # Log entries keep their global indices: self.log holds only the
595	        # uncompacted suffix, so entry for global index i is self.log[i - 1 -
596	        # self.snapshot_index]. snapshot_index/snapshot_term describe the last
597	        # entry folded into the (modeled) snapshot; 0 means no snapshot yet.
598	        self.log: list[dict] = []
599	        self.snapshot_index = 0
600	        self.snapshot_term = 0
601	        # Configuration in effect at snapshot_index (None before any
602	        # snapshot). Config entries can be compacted into snapshots like any
603	        # committed entry, so membership survives compaction.
604	        self.snapshot_config: dict | None = None
605	        self.commit_index = 0
606	        self.last_applied = 0
607	        self.applied: list[dict] = []
608	        # Leader-only replication progress, keyed by peer name.
609	        self.next_index: dict[str, int] = {}
610	        self.match_index: dict[str, int] = {}
611	        # Crash/restart lifecycle. term, voted_for, log, snapshot_index,
612	        # snapshot_term, snapshot_config, commit_index, last_applied, applied
613	        # and the configuration encoded in the log all model persisted state:
614	        # every change to them is made (synchronously) before the response that
615	        # depends on it, so they survive a crash and are simply kept on
616	        # restart. Everything else is volatile and is reset on restart.
617	        self.online = True
618	        self.restart_count = 0
619	
620	    def last_log_index(self) -> int:
621	        return self.snapshot_index + len(self.log)
622	
623	    def last_log_term(self) -> int:
624	        return self.log[-1]["term"] if self.log else self.snapshot_term
625	
626	    def term_at(self, index: int) -> int:
627	        if index <= 0:
628	            return 0
629	        if index == self.snapshot_index:
630	            return self.snapshot_term
631	        if index < self.snapshot_index:
632	            raise IndexError(f"index {index} is covered by the snapshot")
633	        return self.log[index - 1 - self.snapshot_index]["term"]
634	
635	    def has_entry(self, index: int) -> bool:
636	        return self.snapshot_index < index <= self.last_log_index()
637	
638	    def config_at(self, index: int, initial_config: dict) -> dict | None:
639	        """The configuration in effect immediately *before* the entry at
640	        ``index`` is applied: the latest config entry with a smaller index, or
641	        the snapshot config / initial configuration. Returns None when no
642	        configuration entry precedes ``index`` (the caller substitutes the
643	        initial configuration)."""
644	        config = self.snapshot_config if self.snapshot_config else initial_config
645	        upper = min(index - 1, self.last_log_index())
646	        for i in range(self.snapshot_index + 1, upper + 1):
647	            entry = self.log[i - 1 - self.snapshot_index]
648	            if entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG:
649	                config = entry["config"]
650	        return config
651	
652	    def latest_config(self, initial_config: dict) -> dict:
653	        """The newest configuration present in this node's log (or its
654	        snapshot), whether or not it is committed or applied."""
655	        result = self.snapshot_config if self.snapshot_config else initial_config
656	        for entry in self.log:
657	            if entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG:
658	                result = entry["config"]
659	        return result
660	
661	    def committed_config(self, initial_config: dict) -> dict:
662	        """The configuration established by the newest committed config
663	        entry (or the snapshot config, which only covers committed state)."""
664	        config = self.snapshot_config if self.snapshot_config else initial_config
665	        upper = min(self.commit_index, self.last_log_index())
666	        for i in range(self.snapshot_index + 1, upper + 1):
667	            entry = self.log[i - 1 - self.snapshot_index]
668	            if entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG:
669	                config = entry["config"]
670	        return config

765	    def run(self) -> dict:
766	        for order, fault in enumerate(self.faults):
767	            heapq.heappush(self.queue, (fault["time"], _KIND_FAULT, order, fault))
768	        for order, event in enumerate(self.node_events):

770	        for order, command in enumerate(self.commands):

773	            heapq.heappush(self.queue, (change["time"], _KIND_MEMBERSHIP, order, change))
774	        for order, query in enumerate(self.read_queries):
775	            heapq.heappush(self.queue, (query["time"], _KIND_READ, order, query))
776	        for name in self.node_names:
777	            if self._is_voter(name, self.initial_config):
778	                heapq.heappush(self.queue, (self.timeouts[name], _KIND_TIMEOUT, self.index[name], (name, 0)))
779	        if self.liveness_provided:
780	            # Anchors at every window edge guarantee evaluation also runs at
781	            # timestamps carrying no pre-existing events; all other timestamps
782	            # are reached via the drain hook in the loop below.
783	            anchors = sorted({
784	                edge
785	                for check in self.liveness_checks
786	                for edge in (check["startTime"], check["deadline"])
787	            })
788	            for order, edge in enumerate(anchors):
789	                heapq.heappush(self.queue, (edge, _KIND_LIVENESS, order, None))
790	        while self.queue:
791	            time, kind, _order, payload = heapq.heappop(self.queue)
792	            if time > self.duration:
793	                break
794	            self.now = time
795	            self.reaction_phase = kind in (_KIND_CLIENT, _KIND_MEMBERSHIP, _KIND_READ, _KIND_REACTION)
796	            if kind == _KIND_FAULT:
797	                self._apply_fault(payload)
798	            elif kind == _KIND_NODE_EVENT:
799	                self._on_node_event(payload)
800	            elif kind in (_KIND_MESSAGE, _KIND_REACTION):
801	                self._deliver(payload)
802	            elif kind == _KIND_CLIENT:
803	                self._on_client_command(payload)
804	            elif kind == _KIND_MEMBERSHIP:
805	                self._on_membership_change(payload)
806	            elif kind == _KIND_READ:
807	                self._on_read_query(payload)
808	            elif kind == _KIND_TIMEOUT:
809	                self._on_timeout(*payload)
810	            elif kind == _KIND_HEARTBEAT:
811	                self._on_heartbeat(*payload)
812	            # The liveness anchor itself is a no-op: it only marks a window
813	            # edge that carries no other events. Either way, once no entry
814	            # remains for the current timestamp (its zero-delay reactions
815	            # included), the timestamp has fully drained and the checks run.
816	            if (
817	                self.liveness_provided
818	                and self.liveness_checks
819	                and (not self.queue or self.queue[0][0] > self.now)
820	            ):
821	                self._evaluate_liveness(self.now)
822	        return self._report()

880	    def _joint_config(self, voters: frozenset[str], action: str, member: str) -> dict:

892	    def _has_vote_majorities(self, candidate: str, votes: set[str], config: dict) -> bool:
893	        for group in self._config_quorums(config):
894	            needed = len(group) // 2 + 1
895	            if len([v for v in votes if v in group]) < needed:
896	                return False
897	        return True

899	    def _replicated_by_majorities(self, leader: str, index: int, config: dict) -> bool:
900	        """Whether ``index`` is present on a strict majority of every quorum
901	        group (the leader itself counts in any group it belongs to)."""
902	        st = self.state[leader]
903	        for group in self._config_quorums(config):
904	            needed = len(group) // 2 + 1
905	            points = []
906	            for peer in group:
907	                if peer == leader:
908	                    points.append(st.last_log_index())
909	                else:
910	                    points.append(st.match_index.get(peer, 0))
911	            if len([point for point in points if point >= index]) < needed:
912	                return False
913	        return True

986	    def _become_leader(self, name: str, config: dict) -> None:
987	        st = self.state[name]
988	        st.role = ROLE_LEADER
989	        st.known_leader = name
990	        st.votes = set()
991	        st.timeout_gen += 1  # leaders have no election timeout
992	        next_index = st.last_log_index() + 1
993	        # Replication progress is tracked for every other node: voters count
994	        # towards quorums, learners receive the log but never count.

1004	    def _resume_membership_change(self, name: str) -> None:
1005	        """Finish a change a previous leader left open. If the newest config
1006	        entry present is a joint entry (with no stable entry following it),
1007	        append the stable entry now: winning this term's election required
1008	        majorities of both joint sets, so the joint entry is known to be on
1009	        those majorities even before commitIndex advanced to it."""
1010	        st = self.state[name]
1011	        if st.latest_config(self.initial_config).get("type") == CONFIG_JOINT:
1012	            joint_entry = None
1013	            # Newest joint entry in the uncompacted log, otherwise the newest
1014	            # one folded into the snapshot's applied history.
1015	            for log_entry in reversed(st.log):
1016	                if log_entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG and log_entry["entryType"] == CONFIG_JOINT:
1017	                    joint_entry = log_entry
1018	                    break
1019	            if joint_entry is None:
1020	                for applied in reversed(st.applied):
1021	                    if (
1022	                        applied.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG
1023	                        and applied["entryType"] == CONFIG_JOINT
1024	                    ):
1025	                        joint_entry = applied
1026	                        break
1027	            if joint_entry is not None:
1028	                _old, new_voters = self._config_groups(joint_entry["config"])
1029	                stable = self._stable_config(new_voters)
1030	                self._append_config_entry(
1031	                    name,
1032	                    joint_entry["id"],
1033	                    CONFIG_STABLE,
1034	                    stable,
1035	                    joint_entry["action"],
1036	                    joint_entry["member"],
1037	                )
1038	                for peer in self.node_names:
1039	                    if peer != name:
1040	                        self._replicate_to(name, peer)
1041	        if self.pending_catchup is not None:
1042	            if self.pending_catchup["leader"] != name:
1043	                # The old leader was replaced before it appended the joint
1044	                # entry; the unfinished catch-up is abandoned.
1045	                self.pending_catchup = None
1046	            else:
1047	                self._progress_catchup(name)

1051	    @staticmethod
1052	    def _query_id_field(msg: dict) -> dict:
1053	        """Read-confirmation messages (readProbe/readReply) carry the query id
1054	        into their timeline entries; no other message kind has one."""
1055	        return {"id": msg["id"]} if "id" in msg else {}

1057	    def _send(self, src: str, dst: str, msg: dict) -> None:
1058	        self._record({
1059	            "type": "messageSend",
1060	            "node": src,
1061	            "peer": dst,
1062	            "message": msg["kind"],
1063	            "term": msg["term"],
1064	            **self._query_id_field(msg),
1065	        })
1066	        self.send_counter += 1
1067	        envelope = {**msg, "src": src, "dst": dst}
1068	        # A messageFaults rule matches the occurrence-th actual send of its
1069	        # (from, to, message) selector. The fault is recorded right after the
1070	        # send; a drop replaces delivery with a dropped/messageFault result at
1071	        # the originally scheduled arrival, a delay shifts the arrival itself.
1072	        count_key = (src, dst, msg["kind"])
1073	        occurrence = self.message_fault_counts.get(count_key, 0) + 1
1074	        self.message_fault_counts[count_key] = occurrence
1075	        rule = self.message_faults.get((src, dst, msg["kind"], occurrence))
1076	        extra_delay = 0
1077	        if rule is not None:
1078	            scheduled = self.now + self.delay
1079	            fault_entry = {
1080	                "type": "messageFault",
1081	                "rule": rule["index"],
1082	                "from": src,
1083	                "to": dst,
1084	                "message": msg["kind"],
1085	                "occurrence": occurrence,
1086	                "action": rule["action"],
1087	                "scheduledTime": scheduled,
1088	            }
1089	            if rule["action"] == "drop":
1090	                envelope["faultDrop"] = True
1091	            else:
1092	                extra_delay = rule["delay"]
1093	                fault_entry["arrivalTime"] = scheduled + extra_delay
1094	            self._record(fault_entry)
1095	        effective_delay = self.delay + extra_delay
1096	        # Zero-delay replication triggered while draining a client-command
1097	        # batch shares the batch's timestamp and must follow the remaining
1098	        # client commands; a positive delay lands strictly in the future and
1099	        # queues as a normal message arrival.
1100	        in_phase = self.reaction_phase and effective_delay == 0
1101	        kind = _KIND_REACTION if in_phase else _KIND_MESSAGE
1102	        heapq.heappush(self.queue, (self.now + effective_delay, kind, self.send_counter, envelope))

1104	    def _send_heartbeats(self, name: str) -> None:
1105	        """Per peer, send either a log-carrying appendEntries (when the peer is
1106	        behind) or a bare heartbeat (when its log already matches). Mixing the
1107	        two would let an empty heartbeat's leaderCommit make a divergent peer
1108	        apply entries that the appendEntries is about to overwrite. The
1109	        appendEntries handler truncates, appends and advances the commit in one
1110	        atomic step, so it alone is safe for a lagging peer."""
1111	        st = self.state[name]
1112	        for peer in self.node_names:
1113	            if peer == name:
1114	                continue
1115	            if st.match_index[peer] < st.last_log_index():
1116	                self._replicate_to(name, peer)
1117	            else:
1118	                self._send(
1119	                    name,
1120	                    peer,
1121	                    {"kind": "heartbeat", "term": st.term, "leaderCommit": st.commit_index},
1122	                )
1123	        heapq.heappush(
1124	            self.queue,
1125	            (self.now + self.heartbeat_interval, _KIND_HEARTBEAT, self.index[name], (name, st.term)),
1126	        )

1128	    def _replicate_to(self, name: str, peer: str) -> None:
1129	        """Send the next due message for one peer: an installSnapshot when the
1130	        peer's next position is already covered by the leader's snapshot,
1131	        otherwise an appendEntries carrying the uncompacted suffix slice."""
1132	        st = self.state[name]
1133	        next_idx = st.next_index[peer]
1134	        if next_idx <= st.snapshot_index:
1135	            # The snapshot bundles the applied state through lastIncludedIndex.
1136	            snapshot_entries = [dict(entry) for entry in st.applied[: st.snapshot_index]]
1137	            self._send(
1138	                name,
1139	                peer,
1140	                {
1141	                    "kind": "installSnapshot",
1142	                    "term": st.term,
1143	                    "lastIncludedIndex": st.snapshot_index,
1144	                    "lastIncludedTerm": st.snapshot_term,
1145	                    "entries": snapshot_entries,
1146	                },
1147	            )
1148	            return
1149	        prev_idx = next_idx - 1
1150	        entries = [dict(entry) for entry in st.log[next_idx - 1 - st.snapshot_index:]]
1151	        self._send(
1152	            name,
1153	            peer,
1154	            {
1155	                "kind": "appendEntries",
1156	                "term": st.term,
1157	                "prevLogIndex": prev_idx,
1158	                "prevLogTerm": st.term_at(prev_idx),
1159	                "entries": entries,
1160	                "leaderCommit": st.commit_index,
1161	            },
1162	        )

1169	    def _deliver(self, msg: dict) -> None:
1170	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
1171	        if msg.get("faultDrop"):
1172	            # A messageFaults drop rule: the message never reaches the
1173	            # receiver, reported at its originally scheduled arrival time.
1174	            self._record({
1175	                "type": "messageResult",
1176	                "node": dst,
1177	                "peer": src,
1178	                "message": msg["kind"],
1179	                "term": msg["term"],
1180	                **self._query_id_field(msg),
1181	                "result": "dropped",
1182	                "reason": "messageFault",
1183	            })
1184	            return
1185	        if not self.state[dst].online:
1186	            # The destination crashed after this message was sent; it is
1187	            # dropped on arrival. Messages the crashed node itself sent
1188	            # earlier are unaffected and still land at their original time.
1189	            self._record({
1190	                "type": "messageResult",
1191	                "node": dst,
1192	                "peer": src,
1193	                "message": msg["kind"],
1194	                "term": msg["term"],
1195	                **self._query_id_field(msg),
1196	                "result": "dropped",
1197	                "reason": "nodeDown",
1198	            })
1199	            return
1200	        if not self._connected(src, dst):
1201	            self._record({
1202	                "type": "messageResult",
1203	                "node": dst,
1204	                "peer": src,
1205	                "message": msg["kind"],
1206	                "term": msg["term"],
1207	                **self._query_id_field(msg),
1208	                "result": "dropped",
1209	                "reason": "partition",
1210	            })
1211	            return
1212	        kind = msg["kind"]
1213	        if kind == "requestVote":
1214	            self._handle_request_vote(msg)
1215	        elif kind == "voteReply":
1216	            self._handle_vote_reply(msg)
1217	        elif kind == "heartbeat":
1218	            self._handle_heartbeat(msg)
1219	        elif kind == "appendEntries":
1220	            self._handle_append_entries(msg)
1221	        elif kind == "installSnapshot":
1222	            self._handle_install_snapshot(msg)
1223	        elif kind == "installSnapshotReply":
1224	            self._handle_snapshot_reply(msg)
1225	        elif kind == "readProbe":
1226	            self._handle_read_probe(msg)
1227	        elif kind == "readReply":
1228	            self._handle_read_reply(msg)
1229	        else:
1230	            self._handle_append_reply(msg)

1232	    def _handle_request_vote(self, msg: dict) -> None:
1233	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
1234	        st = self.state[dst]
1235	        # A higher term clears voted_for before the vote decision is made.
1236	        effective_voted_for = None if msg["term"] > st.term else st.voted_for
1237	        up_to_date = (
1238	            msg["lastLogTerm"] > st.last_log_term()
1239	            or (
1240	                msg["lastLogTerm"] == st.last_log_term()
1241	                and msg["lastLogIndex"] >= st.last_log_index()
1242	            )
1243	        )
1244	        # Learners and removed members never grant a vote; candidates only
1245	        # solicit voters, so stale RVs reaching a demoted node are denied.
1246	        eligible_voter = self._can_vote(dst)
1247	        granted = (
1248	            eligible_voter
1249	            and msg["term"] >= st.term
1250	            and up_to_date
1251	            and (effective_voted_for is None or effective_voted_for == src)
1252	        )
1253	        self._record({
1254	            "type": "messageResult",
1255	            "node": dst,
1256	            "peer": src,
1257	            "message": "requestVote",
1258	            "term": msg["term"],
1259	            "result": "delivered",
1260	            "detail": "voteGranted" if granted else "voteDenied",
1261	        })

1263	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "higherTermMessage")

1294	    def _handle_heartbeat(self, msg: dict) -> None:
1295	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]

1297	        accepted = msg["term"] >= st.term
1298	        self._record({
1299	            "type": "messageResult",
1300	            "node": dst,
1301	            "peer": src,
1302	            "message": "heartbeat",
1303	            "term": msg["term"],
1304	            "result": "delivered",
1305	            "detail": "accepted" if accepted else "staleTerm",
1306	        })

1940	    def _handle_read_reply(self, msg: dict) -> None:
1941	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
1942	        st = self.state[dst]
1943	        query_id = msg["id"]
1944	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
1945	            self._record({
1946	                "type": "messageResult",
1947	                "node": dst,
1948	                "peer": src,
1949	                "message": "readReply",
1950	                "term": msg["term"],
1951	                "id": query_id,
1952	                "result": "delivered",
1953	                "detail": "higherTerm",
1954	            })

2030	    def _change_in_progress(self, st: _Node, leader: str) -> bool:
2031	        pending = self.pending_catchup

2063	    def _on_membership_change(self, change: dict) -> None:
2064	        node = change["node"]
2065	        change_id = change["id"]
2066	        action = change["action"]
2067	        member = change["member"]
2068	        st = self.state[node]
2069	        # Rejection precedence: receiver down -> not the leader -> another
2070	        # change already running -> member state not applicable -> removing
2071	        # would leave fewer than three voters.
2072	        if not st.online:
2073	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "nodeDown")
2074	            return
2075	        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER:
2076	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "notLeader")
2077	            return
2078	        if self._change_in_progress(st, node):
2079	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "changeInProgress")
2080	            return
2081	        _, voters = self._config_groups(st.committed_config(self.initial_config))
2082	        voters = frozenset(voters)
2083	        if action == "add":
2084	            if member in voters:
2085	                self._record_membership_rejected(change, "alreadyMember")
2086	                return
2087	            new_voters = voters | {member}
2088	        else:
2089	            if member not in voters:
2090	                self._record_membership_rejected(change, "notMember")
2091	                return
2092	            new_voters = voters - {member}
2093	        if len(new_voters) < 3:
2094	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "minimumClusterSize")
2095	            return
2096	
2097	        self.change_results[change_id] = {
2098	            "node": node,
2099	            "action": action,
2100	            "member": member,
2101	            "outcome": "pending",
2102	        }
2103	        if action == "add":
2104	            # The learner must first receive the log (or a snapshot) until it
2105	            # matches the leader; only then is the joint config entry
2106	            # appended. Heartbeats already stream entries to every node, but

2110	                "member": member,
2111	                "action": action,
2112	                "leader": node,
2113	            }

2115	                "type": "membershipResult",

2162	    def _progress_catchup(self, name: str) -> None:
2163	        """Append the joint entry once the added learner has caught the
2164	        leader's log end (via log replication or an installed snapshot)."""
2165	        pending = self.pending_catchup
2166	        if pending is None:
2167	            return
2168	        st = self.state[name]
2169	        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER or pending["leader"] != name:
2170	            return
2171	        member = pending["member"]
2172	        latest = st.latest_config(self.initial_config)
2173	        if latest.get("type") == CONFIG_JOINT:
2174	            # Another change already moved the cluster into a joint phase.
2175	            return
2176	        _, voters = self._config_groups(st.committed_config(self.initial_config))
2177	        voters = frozenset(voters)
2178	        if (pending["action"] == "add") == (member in voters):

2180	            return
2181	        if st.match_index.get(member, 0) < st.last_log_index():

2188	    def _advance_leader_commit(self, name: str) -> None:
2189	        st = self.state[name]
2190	        replicated = sorted([st.last_log_index()] + list(st.match_index.values()), reverse=True)
2191	        # Entries replicated while a joint configuration is active need
2192	        # strict majorities of BOTH voter sets; entries before/after it use
2193	        # the single stable set.
2194	        for candidate in replicated:
2195	            if candidate <= st.commit_index:
2196	                break
2197	            if st.term_at(candidate) != st.term:
2198	                continue
2199	            # A server uses the newest config in its log as soon as it is
2200	            # appended, so the joint entry is committed by majorities of
2201	            # BOTH sets; the stable entry is only appended after the joint
2202	            # entry commits, so it and later entries use the new single set.
2203	            config = st.config_at(candidate + 1, self.initial_config)
2204	            if self._replicated_by_majorities(name, candidate, config):
2205	                # Track the client commands this commit covers so that reads
2206	                # accepted later can be checked for staleness.
2207	                for index in range(st.commit_index + 1, candidate + 1):
2208	                    view = self._entry_view(st, index)
2209	                    if view is not None and view.get("kind") != KIND_CONFIG:
2210	                        self.committed_command_ids.add(view["id"])
2211	                st.commit_index = candidate
2212	                self._record({
2213	                    "type": "commitAdvance",
2214	                    "node": name,
2215	                    "term": st.term,
2216	                    "commitIndex": st.commit_index,
2217	                })
2218	                self._advance_apply(name)
2219	                return

2221	    def _advance_apply(self, name: str) -> None:
2222	        st = self.state[name]
2223	        while st.last_applied < st.commit_index:
2224	            next_index = st.last_applied + 1
2225	            if not st.has_entry(next_index):
2226	                break
2227	            st.last_applied = next_index
2228	            entry = st.log[next_index - 1 - st.snapshot_index]
2229	            if entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG:
2230	                st.applied.append(self._applied_config_view(entry))
2231	                self._apply_config_entry(name, entry)
2232	            else:
2233	                st.applied.append(
2234	                    self._command_entry(
2235	                        entry["index"], entry["term"], entry["id"], entry["command"]
2236	                    )
2237	                )
2238	                self._record({
2239	                    "type": "applied",
2240	                    "node": name,
2241	                    "index": entry["index"],
2242	                    "term": entry["term"],
2243	                    "id": entry["id"],
2244	                })
2245	            if (
2246	                self.snapshot_threshold is not None
2247	                and st.last_applied - st.snapshot_index >= self.snapshot_threshold
2248	            ):
2249	                self._create_snapshot(name)

2264	    @staticmethod
2265	    def _has_following_stable(st: _Node, joint_entry: dict) -> bool:
2266	        """Whether a stable entry for the same change already follows the
2267	        joint entry in this node's log (e.g. appended when this leader first
2268	        won the election)."""
2269	        for log_entry in st.log:
2270	            if (
2271	                log_entry["index"] > joint_entry["index"]
2272	                and log_entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG
2273	                and log_entry["entryType"] == CONFIG_STABLE

2279	    def _apply_config_entry(self, name: str, entry: dict) -> None:
2280	        """React to a newly committed configuration: emit configurationApplied,
2281	        start/stop election timers when membership changes, append the stable
2282	        entry after a joint entry commits (on the leader), and make a removed
2283	        leader step down once the stable configuration is committed."""
2284	        st = self.state[name]
2285	        config = entry["config"]
2286	        old, new = self._config_groups(config)
2287	        self._record({
2288	            "type": "configurationApplied",
2289	            "node": name,
2290	            "index": entry["index"],
2291	            "term": entry["term"],
2292	            "id": entry["id"],
2293	            "entryType": entry["entryType"],
2294	            "config": config,
2295	            "action": entry["action"],
2296	            "member": entry["member"],
2297	        })
2298	        if entry["entryType"] == CONFIG_STABLE:
2299	            # A stable entry keeps the new set in both halves, so the removed
2300	            # members come from the preceding joint configuration (old set)
2301	            # rather than from this entry itself.
2302	            prior_old, _prior_new = self._config_groups(
2303	                st.config_at(entry["index"], self.initial_config)
2304	            )
2305	            removed = prior_old - new
2306	            result = self.change_results.get(entry["id"])
2307	            if result is not None and result.get("outcome") != "committed":
2308	                result["outcome"] = "committed"
2309	                result["index"] = entry["index"]
2310	                result["term"] = entry["term"]
2311	                result.pop("jointPhase", None)
2312	            # The first application of the stable entry is the moment the
2313	            # change commits; later nodes applying it must not move the time.
2314	            self.stable_commit_times.setdefault(entry["id"], self.now)
2315	            # A leader removed by the change it proposed steps down at once;
2316	            # its latest configuration no longer contains it, so it neither
2317	            # campaigns nor votes afterwards.
2318	            if name in removed and st.role == ROLE_LEADER:
2319	                self._leader_removed(name, entry)
2320	        else:
2321	            result = self.change_results.get(entry["id"])
2322	            if result is not None:
2323	                result["jointPhase"] = {"id": entry["id"], "old": sorted(old), "new": sorted(new)}
2324	            if st.role == ROLE_LEADER and not self._has_following_stable(st, entry):
2325	                # The joint configuration is committed (or, for a leader that
2326	                # won after the joint entry was already on both majorities, is
2327	                # being caught up): append the stable configuration. A new
2328	                # leader may already have appended one in _become_leader, in
2329	                # which case it must not be duplicated.
2330	                stable = self._stable_config(new)
2331	                self._append_config_entry(
2332	                    name, entry["id"], CONFIG_STABLE, stable, entry["action"], entry["member"]
2333	                )
2334	                for peer in self.node_names:
2335	                    if peer != name:
2336	                        self._replicate_to(name, peer)

2338	    def _leader_removed(self, name: str, entry: dict) -> None:
2339	        st = self.state[name]
2340	        st.role = ROLE_FOLLOWER
2341	        st.known_leader = None
2342	        st.votes = set()
2343	        st.next_index = {}
2344	        st.match_index = {}
2345	        # _reset_timeout cancels the timer for a now non-voting node.

2350	    def _create_snapshot(self, name: str) -> None:
2351	        """Fold every applied entry through last_applied into the snapshot and
2352	        delete the compacted prefix. Global indices are preserved: the
2353	        surviving log suffix keeps its indices and commitIndex/lastApplied are
2354	        not renumbered. The configuration in force at the snapshot index is
2355	        folded in as well, so membership survives compaction."""
2356	        st = self.state[name]
2357	        target = st.last_applied
2358	        cut = target - st.snapshot_index
2359	        included_term = st.log[cut - 1]["term"]
2360	        config = st.snapshot_config if st.snapshot_config else self.initial_config
2361	        for offset in range(cut):
2362	            entry = st.log[offset]
2363	            if entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG:
2364	                config = entry["config"]
2365	        st.snapshot_index = target
2366	        st.snapshot_term = included_term
2367	        st.snapshot_config = self._store_config(config)
2368	        del st.log[:cut]
2369	        self._record({
2370	            "type": "snapshotCreated",
2371	            "node": name,
2372	            "lastIncludedIndex": target,
2373	            "lastIncludedTerm": included_term,
2374	        })

2394	    def _on_node_event(self, event: dict) -> None:
2395	        name = event["node"]
2396	        st = self.state[name]
2397	        if event["action"] == "crash":
2398	            # The node goes silent: it sends nothing, processes nothing and
2399	            # fires no timeouts or heartbeats until it restarts. Persisted
2400	            # state (term, voted_for, log, commit_index, last_applied,
2401	            # applied) is kept as-is.
2402	            st.online = False
2403	            st.timeout_gen += 1  # invalidate any pending election timeout
2404	            self._record({"type": "nodeLifecycle", "node": name, "action": "crash"})
2405	            # A crashed leader cannot confirm the reads it accepted.
2406	            self._abandon_reads(name)
2407	            return
2408	        # Restart: persisted state survives; volatile state is reset. The
2409	        # node comes back as a follower with no known leader, no candidate
2410	        # votes and no leader replication progress, and its election timeout
2411	        # is measured from the restart moment. Recovered entries are not
2412	        # re-applied because last_applied/applied were restored with the log.
2413	        st.online = True
2414	        st.restart_count += 1
2415	        st.role = ROLE_FOLLOWER
2416	        st.known_leader = None
2417	        st.votes = set()
2418	        st.next_index = {}
2419	        st.match_index = {}
2420	        self._reset_timeout(name)
2421	        self._record({"type": "nodeLifecycle", "node": name, "action": "restart"})

    def _handle_append_reply(self, msg: dict) -> None:
        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
        st = self.state[dst]
        if msg["term"] > st.term:
            self._record({
                "type": "messageResult",
                "node": dst,
                "peer": src,
                "message": "appendReply",
                "term": msg["term"],
                "result": "delivered",
                "detail": "higherTerm",
            })
            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "higherTermMessage")
            return
        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER or msg["term"] != st.term:
            self._record({
                "type": "messageResult",
                "node": dst,
                "peer": src,
                "message": "appendReply",
                "term": msg["term"],
                "result": "delivered",
                "detail": "ignored",
            })
            return

        if msg["success"]:
            # A follower with a longer divergent suffix can acknowledge a
            # batch whose shared positions already match; the leader must not
            # treat positions beyond its own log end as replicated.
            match = min(msg["matchIndex"], st.last_log_index())
            advanced = match > st.match_index[src]
            if advanced:
                st.match_index[src] = match
                if match + 1 > st.next_index[src]:
                    st.next_index[src] = match + 1
            self._record({
                "type": "messageResult",
                "node": dst,
                "peer": src,
                "message": "appendReply",
                "term": msg["term"],
                "result": "delivered",
                "detail": "matched",
                "matchIndex": st.match_index[src],
            })
            if advanced:
                self._advance_leader_commit(dst)
            self._progress_catchup(dst)
            return

        # Deterministic backoff: retry one log position earlier.
        if st.next_index[src] > 1:
            st.next_index[src] -= 1
        self._record({
            "type": "messageResult",
            "node": dst,
            "peer": src,
            "message": "appendReply",
            "term": msg["term"],
            "result": "delivered",
            "detail": "conflict",
            "nextIndex": st.next_index[src],
        })
        self._replicate_to(dst, src)

    @staticmethod
    def _read_state_entry(entry: dict) -> dict:
        """The read-state view of one applied client command. Configuration
        entries never appear in a read state."""

            "index": entry["index"],
            "term": entry["term"],
            "id": entry["id"],
